entities.name: Muirchertach Mac Lochlainn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muircheartach Mac Lochlainn was king of Tír Eoghain, and High King of Ireland from around 1156 until his death in 1166. He succeeded Toirdhealbhach Ua Conchobhair who died in 1156.
